sentences.en: Today, across the U.S., protests are erupting against orders to remain at home and to restrict people's movements.
sentences.zh: 今天，美国各地爆发了抗议活动，反对居家令和限制民众出行的命令。

sentences.en: Jim Rutenberg on who is behind those protests and what it is they stand to gain from them.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·鲁滕伯格将讲述这些抗议活动背后的推手以及他们能从中获得什么。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, April 22nd.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月22日，星期三。

sentences.en: Jim, tell us about these protests.
sentences.zh: 吉姆，给我们讲讲这些抗议活动吧。

sentences.en: Well, it starts a week ago, Monday, April 13th, kind of out of the blue, seemingly.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这一切始于一周前，4月13日星期一，看起来有点突如其来。

sentences.en: Here is a group of protesters show up in Columbus, Ohio, and demand that Governor DeWine, Republican
sentences.zh: 一群抗议者出现在俄亥俄州哥伦布市，要求德怀恩州长，也就是那位共和党

sentences.en: governor, who's been imposed very strict stay-at-home restrictions, they're demanding reopen the state, reopen the economy.
sentences.zh: 州长，撤销他实施的非常严格的居家限制措施，他们要求重新开放州，重新开放经济。

sentences.en: Let's get back to work.
sentences.zh: 让我们回去工作吧。

sentences.en: Then the next day, there's another rally, this time with the same demands in North Carolina, in Raleigh.
sentences.zh: 第二天，又举行了另一场集会，这次是在北卡罗来纳州的罗利，诉求相同。

sentences.en: And this time the protest results in an arreSt. Then the next day, you have a very big protest, the biggest protest in Michigan.
sentences.zh: 这一次抗议导致了逮捕。接着第二天，密歇根州发生了规模非常大的抗议，是迄今为止最大的一次。

sentences.en: And this one is the biggest one we'd seen, called Operation Gridlock.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们所见过的规模最大的一次，被称为“交通瘫痪行动”。

sentences.en: It's a dreary day in Lansing and all around the state capitol, as far as the eye can see, are lines of cars honking.
sentences.zh: 兰辛市那天天气阴沉，在州议会大厦周围，放眼望去，全是鸣笛的汽车长龙。

sentences.en: Their passengers and their drivers chanting, freedom.
sentences.zh: 车上的乘客和司机高喊着：自由。

sentences.en: Freedom is essential.
sentences.zh: 自由是必需的。

sentences.en: Fear is a choice.
sentences.zh: 恐惧是一种选择。

sentences.en: Their windows open, signs saying, end the lockdown.
sentences.zh: 他们摇下车窗，举着写有“结束封锁”的标语。

sentences.en: Freedom over tyranny.
sentences.zh: 自由高于暴政。

sentences.en: Even Pharaoh freed the slaves during a plague.
sentences.zh: 即使是法老在瘟疫期间也释放了奴隶。

sentences.en: My husband is on unemployment for the first time in our life.
sentences.zh: 我丈夫这辈子第一次领失业救济金。

sentences.en: And it's unwillingly that we're taking unemployment.
sentences.zh: 我们是不得已才领失业救济的。

sentences.en: We want to go back to work.
sentences.zh: 我们想回去工作。

sentences.en: It's time for our state to be opened up.
sentences.zh: 是时候让我们的州重新开放了。

sentences.en: We're tired of not being able to buy the things that we need.
sentences.zh: 我们厌倦了无法购买我们需要的东西。

sentences.en: The only stores open are Walmart.
sentences.zh: 唯一开门的商店是沃尔玛。

sentences.en: That's ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 这太荒谬了。

sentences.en: That's why we're here.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们在这里的原因。

sentences.en: And all of it is directed at Governor Gretchen Whitmer, who has put in some of the toughest stay-at-home restrictions in the whole entire country.
sentences.zh: 所有这些矛头都指向了格雷琴·惠特默州长，她实施了全国范围内最严厉的一些居家限制措施。

sentences.en: And she has bad going to garden shops.
sentences.zh: 而且她还禁止人们去园艺店。

sentences.en: So one of the protesters says to a TV reporter, you can't buy paint.
sentences.zh: 所以其中一位抗议者对电视记者说，你不能买油漆。

sentences.en: You can't buy lawn.
sentences.zh: 你不能买草坪用品。

sentences.en: You can't buy lawn fertilizer or grass seed or whatever.
sentences.zh: 你不能买草坪肥料或草籽之类的东西。

sentences.en: I mean, come on.
sentences.zh: 我是说，拜托。

sentences.en: All statewide.
sentences.zh: 全州范围都这样。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Complaints about people can't go to their second homes.
sentences.zh: 还有人抱怨不能去他们的第二居所。

sentences.en: If you have a second home in the state, you can't visit that second home.
sentences.zh: 如果你在该州有第二居所，你就不能去探访那个第二居所。

sentences.en: But if somebody lives out of state, they can come into a vacation home.
sentences.zh: 但如果有人住在州外，他们却可以来度假屋。

sentences.en: A cardinal sin by the governor to some people is she says, no water skiing, no use of jet skis.
sentences.zh: 对某些人来说，州长犯下的弥天大罪是她说：禁止滑水，禁止使用摩托艇。

sentences.en: This is a lake state, a great lake state.
sentences.zh: 这是一个湖泊之州，一个伟大的湖泊之州。

sentences.en: So there's an incredible pent-up anger, and it's spilling out on these streets.
sentences.zh: 所以有一种难以置信的压抑愤怒，正在这些街道上宣泄出来。

sentences.en: It was the biggest protest to date, and the anger was palpable and seemed very sincere.
sentences.zh: 这是迄今为止规模最大的一次抗议，愤怒显而易见，而且看起来非常真诚。

sentences.en: And Jim, was there a sense in places like Michigan that these grievances are legitimate?
sentences.zh: 吉姆，在密歇根州等地，人们是否认为这些不满是合理的？

sentences.en: Some of these restrictions, for example, on jet skis, motorboats, home garden stores, felt unusual.
sentences.zh: 例如，对摩托艇、汽艇、家庭园艺店的一些限制，感觉很不寻常。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: And, you know, well, on the one hand, though, let's keep one thing in mind.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，一方面，让我们记住一件事。

sentences.en: Michigan has been hit particularly hard.
sentences.zh: 密歇根州受到的打击特别严重。

sentences.en: I mean, they have a tremendous public health burden, and the governor is trying to meet that.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们面临着巨大的公共卫生负担，州长正在努力应对。

sentences.en: On the other hand, she has imposed some of the toughest restrictions in the country.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，她实施了全国最严厉的一些限制措施。

sentences.en: And these are restrictions that go at the very heart of
sentences.zh: 这些限制触及了

sentences.en: American freedom.
sentences.zh: 美国自由的核心。

sentences.en: You can't go to your own home.
sentences.zh: 你不能去你自己的家。

sentences.en: You can't leave your one home for another home.
sentences.zh: 你不能从一个家去往另一个家。

sentences.en: People from two different households can't commingle.
sentences.zh: 来自两个不同家庭的人不能混在一起。

sentences.en: I mean, these go against the kind of fundamental ideas about private property rights.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这些违背了关于私有财产权利的基本理念。

sentences.en: So there's very understandable anger welling up over some of these, no matter what has motivated these restrictions.
sentences.zh: 所以，无论这些限制的动机是什么，对其中一些限制产生非常可以理解的愤怒是必然的。

sentences.en: When the coronavirus hit Michigan in force last month, Whitmer had no clue what to do.
sentences.zh: 当冠状病毒上个月在密歇根州全面爆发时，惠特默根本不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: So she responded with a mixture of comical ineptitude and a weird kind of arbitrary fascism.
sentences.zh: 所以她的反应是一种滑稽的无能和一种奇怪的武断法西斯主义的混合体。

sentences.en: As these protests roll out, they're becoming a cause celeb in conservative media.
sentences.zh: 随着这些抗议活动的展开，它们正在成为保守派媒体追捧的对象。

sentences.en: By the way, there are uprisings all over this country against governors and their restrictions.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，全国各地都在发生针对州长及其限制措施的起义。

sentences.en: They're getting tons of play.
sentences.zh: 它们得到了大量的报道。

sentences.en: Rush Limbaugh, all the talk radio hosts.
sentences.zh: 拉什·林博，还有所有的脱口秀电台主持人。

sentences.en: Stay in our houses.
sentences.zh: 待在我们的房子里。

sentences.en: We bubble people.
sentences.zh: 我们这些被隔离的人。

sentences.en: We've got to be tracked in real time because they're wearing a state police outfit.
sentences.zh: 我们必须被实时追踪，因为他们穿着州警的制服。

sentences.en: Alex Jones, a conspiracy monger online.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯·琼斯，一个网上的阴谋论贩子。

sentences.en: The American spirit is too strong and
sentences.zh: 美国精神太强大了，

sentences.en: Americans are not going to take it.
sentences.zh: 美国人是不会接受的。

sentences.en: And what happened in Lansing today, God bless them, it's going to happen all over the country.
sentences.zh: 今天在兰辛发生的事情，上帝保佑他们，这将在全国各地发生。

sentences.en: But you have ample coverage on Fox News's regular news programming as well.
sentences.zh: 但你在福克斯新闻的常规新闻节目中也有大量的报道。

sentences.en: And in fact, it's on Friday.
sentences.zh: 事实上，是在周五。

sentences.en: In Minnesota, the demonstrators didn't even wait for their own plan.
sentences.zh: 在明尼苏达州，示威者甚至没有等待他们自己的计划。

sentences.en: During a Fox News segment about the protests, this one in Minnesota, we started to see some tweets from the president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 在福克斯新闻关于抗议活动的报道中，这次是在明尼苏达州，我们开始看到来自美国总统的一些推文。

sentences.en: Liberate Minnesota, liberate Michigan, liberate
sentences.zh: 解放明尼苏达，解放密歇根，解放

sentences.en: Virginia, all in capital letters.
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚，全部用大写字母。

sentences.en: So this is the president openly encouraging these protests.
sentences.zh: 所以这是总统在公开鼓励这些抗议活动。

sentences.en: He's taken himself right to the front of the line.
sentences.zh: 他把自己直接推到了最前线。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's around this point that I started to look at this and think this has the makings of a movement.
sentences.zh: 就在这一点上，我开始审视这件事，并认为这具备了一场运动的雏形。

sentences.en: Precisely.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: It's got everything that we've come to see in any modern political movement.
sentences.zh: 它具备了我们在任何现代政治运动中所见的一切。

sentences.en: It's crowds outside of state houses.
sentences.zh: 州议会大厦外的群众。

sentences.en: It's the same sort of signage.
sentences.zh: 同样的标语。

sentences.en: It's a protest movement that's come together very, very fast and getting a lot of tension.
sentences.zh: 这是一场非常、非常迅速地聚集在一起并引起了极大关注的抗议运动。

sentences.en: And we start wondering, my colleague Ken Vogel and I, like, what's behind this?
sentences.zh: 我和我的同事肯·沃格尔开始纳闷，这背后是什么？

sentences.en: Movements, they take some organization.
sentences.zh: 运动，它们需要一些组织。

sentences.en: They take getting the word out to people and negotiating with the authorities on the street about, you know, where the protesters can be, especially in these new conditions.
sentences.zh: 它们需要向人们传达信息，并与街头的当局协商，关于，你知道，抗议者可以在哪里，特别是在这些新的条件下。

sentences.en: So we start wondering, how is this all coming together?
sentences.zh: 所以我们开始纳闷，这一切是如何整合在一起的？

sentences.en: Certainly a movement, but all movements have organizational structures.
sentences.zh: 当然是一场运动，但所有运动都有组织结构。

sentences.en: What's going on here?
sentences.zh: 这里发生了什么？

sentences.en: And what did you find?
sentences.zh: 你发现了什么？

sentences.en: Well, as we often find, it was complicated.
sentences.zh: 嗯，正如我们经常发现的那样，情况很复杂。

sentences.en: It involved some familiar conservative activist groups playing major roles behind the scenes.
sentences.zh: 它涉及一些熟悉的保守派活动团体在幕后扮演主要角色。

sentences.en: Some of the conservative donors who we followed over the years were involved behind the scenes.
sentences.zh: 我们多年来关注的一些保守派捐赠者在幕后参与其中。

sentences.en: There were many tentacles from Washington leading into these various state protests, basically driven by people whose main concern probably isn't solely whether you can
sentences.zh: 从华盛顿延伸到这些各州抗议活动的触角很多，基本上是由那些主要关心的可能不仅仅是你明天是否能

sentences.en: go to the store tomorrow and buy some grass seed.
sentences.zh: 去商店买些草籽的人所驱动的。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费探索《时报》一个月，而不需要输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用程序中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 一个月的时间去深入了解付费墙后的内容，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能得到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So Jim, as you're trying to figure out who and what is behind these protests, where did you start?
sentences.zh: 那么吉姆，当你试图弄清楚谁是这些抗议活动的幕后黑手以及背后是什么时，你从哪里开始的？

sentences.en: Well, the good news for us was at first we didn't have to do a ton of digging.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对我们来说好消息是，起初我们不需要进行大量的挖掘。

sentences.en: It was right there in plain sight in Michigan.
sentences.zh: 它就在密歇根州显而易见的地方。

sentences.en: It turned out that one of the big groups that helped organize the protests, promote the protests, even speak for the protests, was called Michigan Freedom
sentences.zh: 事实证明，帮助组织抗议、推动抗议、甚至为抗议代言的大型团体之一，被称为密歇根自由

sentences.en: Fund.
sentences.zh: 基金。

sentences.en: And Michigan Freedom Fund has as its chairman a gentleman named Greg McNeely.
sentences.zh: 而密歇根自由基金的主席是一位名叫格雷格·麦克尼利的绅士。

sentences.en: It turns out Greg
sentences.zh: 事实证明，格雷格·

sentences.en: McNeely is very close to a big conservative family in Michigan that donates to a lot of conservative causes, the DeVos family.
sentences.zh: 麦克尼利与密歇根州一个向许多保守派事业捐款的大型保守派家族——德沃斯家族非常亲近。

sentences.en: That family's activism in Michigan, especially around charter schools, is what led President Trump to hire one of them, Betsy DeVos, to be his education secretary.
sentences.zh: 那个家族在密歇根州的激进主义，特别是在特许学校方面，导致特朗普总统聘请了他们中的一员，贝齐·德沃斯，担任他的教育部长。

sentences.en: So this is a connection to the White House right there out in the open.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是与白宫的联系，就在那里，公开可见。

sentences.en: Of course,
sentences.zh: 当然，

sentences.en: Mr. McNeely said he was not coordinating with the White House, but the connections were right there in plain sight.
sentences.zh: 麦克尼利先生说他没有与白宫协调，但这些联系就在那里，显而易见。

sentences.en: And it really intrigued a lot of us.
sentences.zh: 这确实引起了我们许多人的兴趣。

sentences.en: Okay, so what did you find next?
sentences.zh: 好的，那你接下来发现了什么？

sentences.en: Then we started looking at some of the Facebook posts for Operation Gridlocks, you know, Facebook
sentences.zh: 然后我们开始查看“交通瘫痪行动”的一些 Facebook 帖子，你知道，Facebook

sentences.en: posts for the Michigan protests, for the protests in New Mexico, for the Maine protests.
sentences.zh: 关于密歇根抗议、新墨西哥抗议、缅因抗议的帖子。

sentences.en: And we noticed that the language for a lot of these promotions for them on Facebook is exactly the same.
sentences.zh: 我们注意到，Facebook 上很多这些促销活动的语言完全相同。

sentences.en: There's a line that runs through a couple of them.
sentences.zh: 其中有几条线索贯穿其中。

sentences.en: People always say conservatives never protest because they are too busy working.
sentences.zh: 人们总是说保守派从不抗议，因为他们太忙于工作了。

sentences.en: Well, guess what?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你猜怎么着？

sentences.en: You're not working, was the joke.
sentences.zh: 你没在工作，这就是笑话。

sentences.en: And this repeats across a lot of these Facebook groups, just, you know, obviously coming from the same place.
sentences.zh: 这在许多这些 Facebook 群组中重复出现，只是，你知道，显然来自同一个地方。

sentences.en: So we don't know where that same place is at this point.
sentences.zh: 所以我们目前不知道那个同一个地方在哪里。

sentences.en: We just know that there's something going on here that's national in scope and involves some coordination.
sentences.zh: 我们只知道这里发生了一些全国范围内的事情，并且涉及一些协调。

sentences.en: Then we get, you know, the kind of thing that happens sometimes that you're very happy when it happens as a reporter is I got a kind of
sentences.zh: 然后我们得到了，你知道，那种有时会发生的事情，作为记者，当它发生时你会非常高兴，我接到了一个来自名为“真北”的进步团体的

sentences.en: out-of-the-blue call from a progressive group called True North.
sentences.zh: 突如其来的电话。

sentences.en: And they found...
sentences.zh: 他们发现……

sentences.en: Hey, if we're live, I'm going to start talking.
sentences.zh: 嘿，如果我们正在直播，我就要开始说话了。

sentences.en: How's that?
sentences.zh: 那样怎么样？

sentences.en: A fascinating little clip from YouTube.
sentences.zh: 一段来自 YouTube 的迷人小片段。

sentences.en: We can talk public policy and drink at the same time.
sentences.zh: 我们可以一边谈论公共政策一边喝酒。

sentences.en: A tiny YouTube show.
sentences.zh: 一个微小的 YouTube 节目。

sentences.en: There are 300 views on this thing.
sentences.zh: 这东西有300次观看。

sentences.en: We decided to call up our old friend, Steve Moore, who's at home.
sentences.zh: 我们决定给我们的老朋友史蒂夫·摩尔打个电话，他现在在家。

sentences.en: Steve, how are you?
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫，你好吗？

sentences.en: So did the Gazette take you back?
sentences.zh: 那么《公报》把你招回去了吗？

sentences.en: No, no.
sentences.zh: 没有，没有。

sentences.en: And it's Stephen Moore, a longtime conservative activiSt.
sentences.zh: 他是斯蒂芬·摩尔，一位长期的保守派活动人士。

sentences.en: My wife says I'm a metrosexual because I'm drinking a wine spritzer.
sentences.zh: 我妻子说我是都市美型男，因为我在喝葡萄酒汽酒。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: A one-time potential nominee for President Trump to the Fed board and a close sort of economic advisor to Trump from the outside.
sentences.zh: 他曾是特朗普总统提名的美联储理事候选人，也是特朗普在体制外的一位经济顾问。

sentences.en: If we don't open the economy by May 1st, we are in really, really deep trouble.
sentences.zh: 如果我们不在5月1日前重启经济，我们将陷入非常、非常严重的困境。

sentences.en: And he says...
sentences.zh: 他说……

sentences.en: We saw more protests today.
sentences.zh: 我们今天看到了更多的抗议活动。

sentences.en: I'm working with a group in Wisconsin that wants to do a drive-in.
sentences.zh: 我正在和威斯康星州的一个团体合作，他们想搞一次驾车抗议。

sentences.en: I'm working with a group to organize a protest in Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 我正在和一个团体合作，在威斯康星州组织一场抗议活动。

sentences.en: This is great.
sentences.zh: 这太棒了。

sentences.en: We have one big donor in Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 我们在威斯康星州有一位大捐款人。

sentences.en: I'm not going to mention his name.
sentences.zh: 我不打算提他的名字。

sentences.en: And I told him about this.
sentences.zh: 我告诉了他这件事。

sentences.en: He said, Steve, I promise I will pay the bail and legal fees for anyone who gets arrested.
sentences.zh: 他说，史蒂夫，我保证会为任何被捕的人支付保释金和法律费用。

sentences.en: And I've even got a donor lined up who's ready to pay the legal fees of anyone who gets arrested.
sentences.zh: 我甚至已经联系好了一位捐款人，他准备为任何被捕的人支付法律费用。

sentences.en: So this is a great time, gentlemen and ladies, for civil disobedience.
sentences.zh: 所以，各位先生女士，现在是进行公民不服从运动的大好时机。

sentences.en: We need to be the Rosa Parks here and protest against these government injustices.
sentences.zh: 我们需要成为这里的罗莎·帕克斯，抗议这些政府的不公正行为。

sentences.en: These are the modern day Rosa Parks fighting for freedom and liberty.
sentences.zh: 这些是为自由和解放而战的现代罗莎·帕克斯。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Everybody here, let's raise a toast to Steve Moore.
sentences.zh: 在座的各位，让我们为史蒂夫·摩尔干杯。

sentences.en: Thank you, gentlemen.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，各位先生。

sentences.en: Thank you, Steve.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，史蒂夫。

sentences.en: Thank you, Steve.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，史蒂夫。

sentences.en: Go Colorado.
sentences.zh: 科罗拉多加油。

sentences.en: Now, we noticed something really interesting about the timing of that video.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们注意到那段视频的时间点有些非常有趣的地方。

sentences.en: He says this on April 14th.
sentences.zh: 他在4月14日说了这些话。

sentences.en: Well, that was an important day for Stephen Moore because he was also named that very same day to a presidential commission about reopening the economy, President
sentences.zh: 嗯，这对斯蒂芬·摩尔来说是个重要的日子，因为就在同一天，他被任命为总统重启经济委员会的成员，也就是特朗普总统的特别工作组。

sentences.en: Trump's sort of task force.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统的特别工作组。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 呵。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And then we started looking at what Stephen Moore had been up to over the past couple of weeks.
sentences.zh: 然后我们开始调查斯蒂芬·摩尔过去几周都在忙些什么。

sentences.en: And it turned out that he was working with a couple of other groups to pressure the
sentences.zh: 结果发现，他一直在与其他几个团体合作，向白宫施压，要求尽早重启经济。

sentences.en: White House to open the economy sooner.
sentences.zh: 白宫重启经济。

sentences.en: Now, two of those groups were called Freedom Works and ALEC.
sentences.zh: 其中两个团体分别是“自由工程”和“美国立法交流委员会”。

sentences.en: And those groups have been major players in the old Tea Party movement.
sentences.zh: 这些团体曾是旧茶党运动的主要参与者。

sentences.en: The Tea Party movement, of course, was this overwhelming conservative sort of rebellion that sprung up
sentences.zh: 当然，茶党运动是大约十年前在全国范围内兴起的一场压倒性的保守派反叛，旨在抗议金融危机后的救助计划以及他们认为奥巴马政府的越权行为。

sentences.en: around the country basically a decade ago to agitate against the bailouts of the financial crisis and their perceived overreach of the Obama administration.
sentences.zh: 抗议金融危机后的救助计划以及他们认为奥巴马政府的越权行为。

sentences.en: Freedom Works had initially been founded with help from the billionaire Koch brothers.
sentences.zh: “自由工程”最初是在亿万富翁科赫兄弟的帮助下成立的。

sentences.en: So it had big billionaire donors behind it.
sentences.zh: 所以它背后有亿万富翁捐款人。

sentences.en: So lo and behold, the next step is Ken Vogel, my colleague who's written a lot about these donors and these issues, finds that Freedom Works has
sentences.zh: 果不其然，下一步是我的同事肯·沃格尔，他写了很多关于这些捐款人和这些问题的文章，他发现“自由工程”本身就直接参与了组织其中一些“重启政府”的抗议活动。

sentences.en: itself been directly involved in helping to organize some of these reopened government protests.
sentences.zh: 本身就直接参与了组织其中一些“重启政府”的抗议活动。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 呵。

sentences.en: So suddenly, these major conservative players turn out to be highly involved in encouraging these protests.
sentences.zh: 所以突然之间，这些主要的保守派参与者被发现高度参与并鼓励这些抗议活动。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And groups that had been through this before during the Tea Party and knew what they were doing.
sentences.zh: 而且这些团体在茶党时期就经历过这些，知道自己在做什么。

sentences.en: And then finally, it comes to our attention that a big law firm has come to the defense of a protester arrested in Raleigh.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们注意到一家大型律师事务所为一名在罗利被捕的抗议者进行了辩护。

sentences.en: This firm is called Michael BeSt. And wouldn't you know it, this firm is very closely tied to the White House.
sentences.zh: 这家律所叫迈克尔·贝斯特。你猜怎么着，这家律所与白宫关系非常密切。

sentences.en: It has among its ranks, Reince Priebus, the former RNC chief and
sentences.zh: 它的成员包括前共和党全国委员会主席、特朗普白宫办公厅主任赖因斯·普里巴斯。

sentences.en: Trump White House chief of staff.
sentences.zh: 特朗普白宫办公厅主任。

sentences.en: It has a lawyer who's currently helping the Trump organization fend off requests from Congress for its tax information.
sentences.zh: 它有一名律师目前正在帮助特朗普集团应对国会对其税务信息的索取。

sentences.en: And then it has an attorney who's currently right now working as a special counsel to President Trump's campaign.
sentences.zh: 它还有一名律师目前正担任特朗普总统竞选团队的特别法律顾问。

sentences.en: This firm just couldn't be more closely connected to the president.
sentences.zh: 这家律所与总统的关系简直不能再紧密了。

sentences.en: We spoke to the partner there in North Carolina who said there was no coordination here.
sentences.zh: 我们采访了北卡罗来纳州的一位合伙人，他说这里面没有协调。

sentences.en: But again, a uncanny connection to President Trump.
sentences.zh: 但话说回来，这与特朗普总统的联系确实令人不可思议。

sentences.en: So what you're finding, Jim, are wealthy conservative donors, well-established conservative activist groups, and some important
sentences.zh: 所以吉姆，你发现的是，富有的保守派捐款人、根基深厚的保守派活动团体，以及一些重要人物，正在将这些抗议活动或其推动力直接与特朗普政府联系起来。

sentences.en: figures that are connecting these protests or their promotion straight back to the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 人物，正在将这些抗议活动或其推动力直接与特朗普政府联系起来。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And what do you make of that?
sentences.zh: 你对此有何看法？

sentences.en: You know, I guess what we do as reporters is we only stick to what our reporting shows.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想我们作为记者，只坚持我们的报道所显示的内容。

sentences.en: So what we don't have reporting, at least as of right now, showing that somehow this was a top
sentences.zh: 所以，至少到目前为止，我们还没有报道显示这在某种程度上是自上而下的，即白宫策划了这个阴谋来制造这些帮助总统的抗议活动。

sentences.en: down, the White House has concocted this plot to create these protests that helped the president.
sentences.zh: 白宫策划了这个阴谋来制造这些帮助总统的抗议活动。

sentences.en: What we do have is people connected to the White House, at least in Mr. Moore's case, directly
sentences.zh: 我们所掌握的是，与白宫有关的人，至少在摩尔先生的案例中，是直接与白宫合作的，他们正在推动这些抗议活动，煽动它们，并在他们认为需要的地方提供财政支持。

sentences.en: working with the White House, are helping these protests along, stoking them, providing them the financial wherewithal where they see they need it.
sentences.zh: 推动这些抗议活动，煽动它们，并在他们认为需要的地方提供财政支持。

sentences.en: Just these tentacles that kind of go to the president and to these major conservative groups that have long been on the scene trying to push against big government.
sentences.zh: 这些触角延伸到了总统和这些长期以来一直试图反对大政府的保守派大团体身上。

sentences.en: And Jim, what is the interest of these conservative groups and activists in pushing, facilitating, encouraging, whatever word you want to use, these protests?
sentences.zh: 吉姆，这些保守派团体和活动人士在推动、促进、鼓励——无论你想用什么词——这些抗议活动中有什么利益？

sentences.en: I mean, to put it simply, what's in it for them?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，简单来说，他们能从中得到什么？

sentences.en: Well, the motivating factors are myriad, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，动机是多种多样的，对吧？

sentences.en: Part of this is these groups are supported by donors who want this economy open.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是这些团体得到了希望经济重启的捐款人的支持。

sentences.en: They want to see cars on the road.
sentences.zh: 他们想看到路上有车在跑。

sentences.en: I mean, have you seen the price of oil lately?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你最近看到油价了吗？

sentences.en: They want people going into stores and buying products, the products they make.
sentences.zh: 他们希望人们走进商店购买产品，购买他们生产的产品。

sentences.en: These donors are very much part of the economy in a very big way.
sentences.zh: 这些捐款人以非常大的方式参与了经济活动。

sentences.en: So there's personal intereSt. There's philosophical intereSt. This is a movement born with the belief in personal freedom and government can't tell you what to do.
sentences.zh: 所以有个人利益。也有哲学上的利益。这是一场建立在个人自由信念基础上的运动，政府不能告诉你该做什么。

sentences.en: But underlying a lot of it in terms of the big donor, big group side, there's also the fact
sentences.zh: 但在大捐款人、大团体的层面下，还有一个事实，那就是整场危机可能对特朗普总统的支持率造成非常大的损害。

sentences.en: that this whole crisis is potentially very damaging to President Trump's approval ratings.
sentences.zh: 整场危机可能对特朗普总统的支持率造成非常大的损害。

sentences.en: And ultimately, and this is the most important ultimate thing here, President Trump's re-election.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，这是最重要的一点，那就是特朗普总统的连任。

sentences.en: All of these groups are heavily invested in seeing him win, most of all, the White House itself, the president.
sentences.zh: 所有这些团体都投入了大量资金希望他获胜，最重要的是白宫本身，也就是总统。

sentences.en: And how does this nascent movement assist in that project of getting President Trump re-elected?
sentences.zh: 那么这场萌芽中的运动如何协助特朗普总统连任的计划呢？

sentences.en: You know, at a time when there can be no rally for President Trump, he can't be in these arenas, this is a form of that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在特朗普总统无法举行集会、无法出现在这些竞技场的时候，这是一种集会的形式。

sentences.en: It's galvanizing people.
sentences.zh: 它在激励人们。

sentences.en: It's hitting their emotions and getting them, actually, amid a pandemic, out in the streets, in many cases, waving his flag.
sentences.zh: 它触动了他们的情绪，让他们在疫情期间走上街头，在许多情况下，挥舞着他的旗帜。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: As much as this may suggest that these protests are not entirely spontaneous, it feels like that's kind of always the case with protests, right?
sentences.zh: 尽管这可能暗示这些抗议并非完全自发，但感觉抗议活动似乎总是这样，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, behind any large crowd on the National Mall or outside a state capitol, it feels like invariably are deep-pocketed donors
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在国家广场或州议会大厦外的任何大规模人群背后，似乎总是少不了财力雄厚的捐款人和专门负责组织人群的活动团体。

sentences.en: and activist groups that specialize in putting people together.
sentences.zh: 财力雄厚的捐款人和专门负责组织人群的活动团体。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, thousands of people don't just show up on their own, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道，成千上万的人不会自己就跑出来，对吧？

sentences.en: So what makes this any different?
sentences.zh: 那么这有什么不同呢？

sentences.en: What makes this one unique in any of our experience is the nature of the proteSt. It's happening during a pandemic.
sentences.zh: 在我们所有人的经验中，这次抗议的独特之处在于其性质。它发生在疫情期间。

sentences.en: And what is being encouraged here, and the organizers are very aware of this and trying
sentences.zh: 这里所鼓励的是——组织者非常清楚这一点，并试图对此保持谨慎——在公共场合与他人接触，而此时在公共场合与他人接触已被视为对公共健康的威胁，这会阻碍我们遏制病毒传播，从而让我们所有人恢复正常。

sentences.en: to be careful about it, is go out in public around other people at a time when going out in public and
sentences.zh: 在公共场合与他人接触，而此时在公共场合与他人接触已被视为对公共健康的威胁，这会阻碍我们遏制病毒传播，从而让我们所有人恢复正常。

sentences.en: being around other people has been deemed a threat to the public health, something that's going to get
sentences.zh: 这会阻碍我们遏制病毒传播，从而让我们所有人恢复正常。

sentences.en: in the way of stopping the spread of this virus so that we can all get back to normal.
sentences.zh: 从而让我们所有人恢复正常。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: So, Jim, that makes me wonder, why would the president, who's out there on Twitter saying
sentences.zh: 所以吉姆，这让我感到好奇，为什么总统会在推特上说“解放密歇根”、“解放弗吉尼亚”、“解放明尼苏达”，为什么他身边的人会想要与这些抗议活动联系在一起，如果存在风险，一个非常真实的风险，即如果这些抗议活动达到了它们的目的，人们最终可能会受到伤害？

sentences.en: liberate Michigan, liberate Virginia, liberate Minnesota, and why would the people around him,
sentences.zh: 解放密歇根、解放弗吉尼亚、解放明尼苏达，为什么他身边的人会想要与这些抗议活动联系在一起，如果存在风险，一个非常真实的风险，即如果这些抗议活动达到了它们的目的，人们最终可能会受到伤害？

sentences.en: why would they want to be associated with these protests if there's a risk, a very real risk,
sentences.zh: 如果存在风险，一个非常真实的风险，即如果这些抗议活动达到了它们的目的，人们最终可能会受到伤害？

sentences.en: that if these protests achieve what they aim to achieve, people could end up getting hurt?
sentences.zh: 人们最终可能会受到伤害？

sentences.en: Well, they're pretty open about that question, and they don't shy away from it, the ones we've talked to.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对于这个问题，他们表现得相当坦率，并没有回避，我们采访过的人都是这样。

sentences.en: And their answer would be some of this, they believe, is being overhyped, that some states may be
sentences.zh: 他们的回答是，他们认为其中一些被过度炒作了，有些州可能比其他州更有条件重启，应该重启，而且一个萎靡不振、萧条的经济对国家的健康是有害的。

sentences.en: in a better position to open than others and should be opened, and that a flailing, depressed economy is bad for the nation's health.
sentences.zh: 有些州可能比其他州更有条件重启，应该重启，而且一个萎靡不振、萧条的经济对国家的健康是有害的。

sentences.en: And at the very bottom of it all is we're a free nation, and this is a cost-benefit analysis that is going to have to be done at some point.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，我们是一个自由的国家，这是一个在某个时候必须进行的成本效益分析。

sentences.en: So there are giant
sentences.zh: 所以这里面有巨大的

sentences.en: ideological questions in this and philosophical questions in this mixed in with the very real
sentences.zh: 意识形态问题和哲学问题，混合着你所指出的非常真实且相当严重、相当严峻的公共健康影响。

sentences.en: public health implications that, as you've pointed out, are pretty serious and pretty severe.
sentences.zh: 非常真实且相当严重、相当严峻的公共健康影响。

sentences.en: I'm curious how successful you think these protests have been so far in achieving their stated goal of pressuring these governors to start easing these lockdowns.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇你认为这些抗议活动在实现其向州长施压以开始放宽封锁的既定目标方面取得了多大的成功。

sentences.en: Well, on the one hand, we're already starting to see an easing in states like South Carolina and
sentences.zh: 嗯，一方面，我们已经开始看到南卡罗来纳州、田纳西州和佐治亚州等州出现了放宽迹象，这些州的州长正在推进重启计划。

sentences.en: Tennessee and Georgia, where those governors are moving ahead with plans to open back up.
sentences.zh: 田纳西州和佐治亚州，这些州的州长正在推进重启计划。

sentences.en: Now, those governors probably were eager to do that anyway and have a political situation in their states where their public is there with them.
sentences.zh: 现在，这些州长可能本来就急于这样做，并且在他们的州内拥有这样的政治局势，即公众与他们站在一起。

sentences.en: In Michigan, however, we see Governor Whitmer sticking to her guns.
sentences.zh: 然而在密歇根州，我们看到惠特默州长坚持己见。

sentences.en: So I think one thing we really have to keep in mind here is so far, this is not the Tea Party.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们在这里必须记住的一点是，到目前为止，这还不是茶党。

sentences.en: It's not an overwhelming, huge protest movement that's going to make every governor buckle.
sentences.zh: 这不是一场会让每一位州长都屈服的压倒性的、巨大的抗议运动。

sentences.en: And in polling, we're still seeing that majorities in this country support these stay-at-home orders and don't want to see the government rush too quickly to reopen everything.
sentences.zh: 在民调中，我们仍然看到这个国家的大多数人支持这些居家令，不希望看到政府太快地匆忙重启一切。

sentences.en: That said, if we've learned anything over the Trump era, it's that the loud minority can really dictate policy.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，如果我们从特朗普时代学到了什么，那就是吵闹的少数派确实可以左右政策。

sentences.en: And that's why we really have to keep an eye on these protests.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们必须密切关注这些抗议活动。

sentences.en: They could tell us a lot about what's going to happen over the coming weeks and months in terms of this country getting back to some semblance of normalcy.
sentences.zh: 它们可以告诉我们很多关于未来几周和几个月内这个国家在恢复某种正常状态方面会发生什么。

sentences.en: And let's not forget, what we've now learned is a lot of very powerful people are invested in seeing these protests continue and grow and ultimately succeed.
sentences.zh: 别忘了，我们现在了解到，许多非常有权势的人都投入了资金，希望看到这些抗议活动持续、壮大并最终取得成功。

sentences.en: Thank you, Jim.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，吉姆。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: back such rules, but would not rule out joining citizens' lawsuits to overturn them.

sentences.en: Pennsylvania, Maine, Virginia, and Kansas.

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
